name: Framework proposal
about: Propose a thinking method for the catalog
title: "[proposal] "
labels: framework-proposal
---

<!--
Before filing: if you have the plugin installed, run the research engine on the method first -
`/think-research-framework <method name>`. It grades evidence conservatively, checks overlap
against the shipped catalog for you, and its output is very nearly this form already.

The bar here is deliberately high and it is written down: docs/contributing.md. Most proposals
are correctly answered "fold into an existing skill" rather than "build". A well-argued fold is
a useful contribution, not a rejection.
-->

**Method (the descriptive name, not the brand):**

**The single durable cognitive move it adds:**
<!-- One sentence. If you need a paragraph, it is probably more than one move, or it is a fold. -->

**Closest shipped skill, and why this is not a fold into it:**
<!-- Name the skill. The distinctness bar is roughly a 20% overlap ceiling: this method may share
     no more than about a fifth of its working mechanism with anything already shipped. -->

**Proposed evidence tier, and 2-3 named sources:**
<!-- Tiers: S strong research / M moderate / P practitioner / V vendor / A anecdotal /
     C conceptually plausible but undertested / X poor or contradictory.
     For each source: author, year, and WHAT IT MEASURED. Most practitioner methods are P -
     proposing P honestly is much better received than arguing an S you cannot support.
     A widely-quoted statistic with no traceable primary source does not count as evidence. -->

**Is the evidence transferred?**
<!-- Yes if the support comes from an adjacent method, or from human-subject studies not
     validated on AI agents. Transferred evidence caps the tier at the conservative grade. -->

**The artifact it emits:**
<!-- Every skill here produces a structured deliverable, not advice. What is the artifact? -->

**When NOT to use it:**
<!-- A skill without a clear wall over-triggers. This section is not optional. -->

**Branded or trademarked?**
<!-- If yes, name the owner and the originating work. The IP gate is open - branded methods are
     documented with proper attribution - but opening the IP gate does not lower the evidence gate. -->

---

<!--
Note on tier-X methods: famous-but-weak frameworks can ship only as caveat-first "contested
lenses" (explicit-request-only, deficiency leading every surface), if at all. See the contested
lens contract in docs/contributing.md before proposing one.
-->
